acceptanceCriteria: A dispatch config with ticketBudget overrides and no default limit validates (test)
Tickets matching no override are never held by budget (test)
dispatch status lists only the override scopes (test)
The governing requirement is amended with a trace; focused budget/config/cli tests pass
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1149 (owner, 2026-10-18). `ticketBudget` requires a default limit (capped at 1000) before any per-ticket, label or kind override can be set. A program that wants caps on only a few tickets must invent a large default, which then appears as a real budget scope in status. Expected: a config with only `overrides` validates; unmatched tickets are never held by the budget; status lists only the override scopes. An explicit `unlimited` default may be accepted instead. The ticketBudget contract lives in the leases spec around line 4325; amend that requirement in place without adding new requirement IDs to the leases spec.
title: dispatch: ticketBudget overrides without a mandatory default limit (GitHub #1149)
